title: Signal: a build that never sets `RestoreLockedMode`
scope: A Directory.Build.props file that declares a lockfile that can be rewritten by a plain restore.
limitations: It matches a lockfile that can be rewritten by a plain restore in the parsed Directory.Build.props; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
fpNotes: A Directory.Build.props that mentions a lockfile that can be rewritten by a plain restore in a comment, a documentation example or a template placeholder is not reported; the rule reads the parsed value that the installer acts on.
